metadata.title: Groupicorn Indiana IOP/PHP research directory
metadata.purpose: Internal discovery/proximity dataset for Groupicorn. Research only; not a clinical referral directory.
metadata.methodology: Physical-address-first. Indiana is represented by an initial regional catchment pair; remaining leads stay in the verification queue until exact-site evidence is checked. September 22, 2026 added an Indianapolis discovery pass with official-site PHP/IOP records for Recovery Centers of America, Valle Vista Health System, Avenues Recovery, and Indiana Teen Treatment Centers. Community Health Network Lawrence Township and Shadeland were also retained from the official clinic directory; Fort Wayne records were not statewide-refreshed.
metadata.branding_note: logo_url points to a tracked PNG asset. Existing asset provenance and license clearance require separate review where source URLs are not yet recorded.
metadata.geocoding_note: Street addresses and ZIP codes are stored where sourced; coordinates are intentionally null pending an audited geocoding pass.
metadata.publication_warning: Verify current program availability, age/track eligibility, insurance, intake requirements, and accepting-patient status before public display or referral use.

research_queue.task: Complete normal web, local-business/Maps, Yelp, Reddit, Psychology Today, SAMHSA FindTreatment.gov, and major health-system/state/county directory searches; record dispositions for every meaningful lead.

research_queue.name: IU Health Addiction Treatment & Recovery Center - Indianapolis
research_queue.task: Exact-site adult IOP and 1701 N. Senate Blvd. evidence is verified from IU Health and Indiana DMHA sources. Acquire and validate an official IU Health PNG logo before adding the provider fragment; do not infer PHP or primary mental-health eligibility from the addiction IOP record.

research_queue.name: Evolve Indy-Addiction and Mental Health Center
research_queue.task: Psychology Today identifies an in-person 8770 Guion Rd Suite B site and PHP/IOP claims. Verify the current official provider site, exact care level, operating status, and official logo before publication; directory evidence alone is not sufficient.

research_queue.name: Hendricks Behavioral Hospital
research_queue.task: Psychology Today reports adult and adolescent psychiatric/dual-diagnosis IOP, but the lead is described as serving the Indianapolis area rather than giving a verified Indianapolis treatment address. Resolve the official physical site and assign the real area before publication.

research_queue.name: Caring Associates Counseling Group
research_queue.task: Psychology Today reports adult and adolescent IOP at 37 Motif Blvd in Brownsburg. Verify the official provider site, current address, exact program status, and whether this should remain in the Indianapolis catchment or receive a separate area; do not treat the directory profile as final evidence.

research_queue.name: Community Fairbanks Recovery Center / Fairbanks
research_queue.task: Official Community Health Network and Joint Commission records support PHP/IOP or high-intensity outpatient at 8102 Clearvista Parkway. Keep this lead grouped with the existing Community Health Network provider rather than creating a duplicate provider group; verify whether a separate location record is needed in a later pass.

research_queue.name: Options Behavioral Health Hospital
research_queue.task: Exclude from publication: the provider's current official page states that the hospital has closed and is no longer accepting patients.

research_queue.name: Charlie Health
research_queue.task: Exclude from this physical-location shortlist: the Indianapolis page describes a virtual IOP and does not establish an Indianapolis treatment site.

research_queue.name: Indianapolis platform discovery leads
research_queue.task: Yelp was blocked by robots.txt, so no Yelp claims were used. Psychology Today leads included Evolve Indy, Avenues Recovery, Indy Teen Treatment Center, Hendricks Behavioral Hospital, Caring Associates, Firefly Children and Family Alliance, Indianapolis Comprehensive Treatment Center, Thrive Mental Health, Care to Change, and Resource Treatment Center: Avenues and ITTC were verified and published; Evolve, Hendricks, and Caring Associates remain queued; Firefly and Care to Change showed general counseling rather than verified IOP/PHP; Indianapolis CTC is opioid MAT rather than strict IOP/PHP; Thrive was virtual-only; Resource Treatment Center described referrals rather than a current local IOP/PHP. Reddit surfaced IU Health, Community, and St. Vincent leads; IU Health remains logo-pending and Community is already represented. SAMHSA/Indiana public-directory searches produced address and level-of-care leads used only for corroboration.
